purpose: Judge-facing evaluation of a public-data experiment. Not official hidden-test or leaderboard results.

definitions.rmse: Root mean squared error in cfs; lower is better; penalizes large errors.
definitions.extreme_rmse: RMSE on actual top 10% discharge within each station, including threshold ties.
definitions.mae: Mean absolute error in cfs; lower is better.
definitions.r2: Proportion of variance explained. Not a percentage of correct predictions; can be negative.

benchmark_note: 2025 is a previously inspected public benchmark, not a new untouched independent test.
official_score_note: Leaderboard normalization depends on all teams and hidden event labels; no official composite score can be claimed here.
